records.statement: Binance's $6.34B company-fund commitment, $5B exact impacted-token holdings, remaining market/OTC acquisition and approximately $3B frozen are company-reported. No token-level XRP replenishment amount, independent audit or current XRP reserve ratio is disclosed.

CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR finding concerns an Ethereum hot wallet and an October 1 snapshot. It does not establish official PoR membership for any of the five XRPL source wallets or rs8Z; the raw official XRP address export remains required.

The reported USDT, USDC, Ripple-frozen assets and USD1 amounts are secondary-reported issuer/executive statements across different chains and token types. Their scopes may overlap the approximately $3B aggregate freeze; Ripple's approximately $200M token identity is unspecified. Do not sum them or infer XRP freeze/recovery.

CoinGecko's approximately $4.067B perpetual OI and TradRadar's approximately $1.85B seven-exchange OI differ in contract universe, venue coverage and capture time. They are not competing measurements of a proven identical universe and must not be averaged.

CoinGecko's aggregate funding is positive while TradRadar's weighted aggregate is negative and venue-specific rates differ. Funding intervals, weighting and contract coverage require normalization before cross-provider comparisons or model use.

Alpha Finance covers five funds through 29 October; XRP Insights covers six spot funds plus BITW, with GXRP flow exclusions and a provisional 30 October row. Holdings-derived changes may include BITW rebalancing and are not identical to issuer creation/redemption reports. Only settled, fund-complete observations should enter the feature store.

CoinGecko's displayed +2%/-2% depth and 24-hour venue volumes are dynamic third-party snapshots. They can change rapidly, may differ by pair and aggregation methodology, and do not guarantee executable liquidity at the captured values.

Ripple says RLUSD collateral availability for Coinbase Global Exchange customers will follow. The announcement confirms current trading/management and chain deposits/withdrawals, not live collateral functionality or any XRP collateral balance.

CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap expose dynamic aggregate price pages without an exact quote timestamp in the captured content. Their similar $1.25 area is useful contextual corroboration, not a synchronized tick or admissible point-in-time training observation.
